meta.title: Pricing - free for Founding Members | Puntr
meta.description: Puntr is free for the first 100 Founding Members. Credits for optional extras are coming later. Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.
meta.ogTitle: Puntr pricing - free for Founding Members
meta.ogDescription: Claim one of 100 Founding spots. Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.

title: Pricing
subtitle: Free for the first 100 Founding Members. Paid extras come later and are optional.

founding.title: Founding Members - free
founding.f1: A permanent Founding badge, numbered #1 to #100
founding.f2: Full access to posting, your record and the weekly leaderboard
founding.f3: 30 free credits a month for 3 months once credits launch

credits.title: Credits - coming soon
credits.note: Indicative prices. They may change before launch.
credits.alwaysFree: Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.

never: Paying will never earn extra points or prize eligibility.

faq.title: Pricing questions
faq.a1: Yes. Founding Members use Puntr free. Posting, voting and the leaderboard are always free.
faq.a2: Not at launch. We will announce credits and their terms before anything goes on sale. The prices here are indicative.
faq.a3: No. Paying will never earn extra points or prize eligibility. Credits only unlock optional extras.
faq.a4: No. Puntr does not take bets, set odds or hold betting funds.
